name: STAIRlab PV testbed, Richmond Field Station (UC Berkeley)
locationBasis: Approximate RFS coordinates; not a surveyed panel position.
orientationBasis: Protocol orientation: both frames face due south. The LiDAR scan is not georeferenced, so each session is rotated so Frame A's plane normal points south; the relative positions and tilts are exactly as scanned.
linkeBasis: Monthly Linke turbidity climatology at the site (pvlib LinkeTurbidities.h5), interpolated between mid-month values; checked by tools/make_reference.py.

module.name: First Solar Series 6 Plus (CdTe thin film)
module.layout: Two portrait modules side by side, wired as one series string per frame; no bypass diodes.

calibration.basis: Least-squares scale between the 14 ten-minute PV readings 11:40-13:50 on 19 Aug 2026 (one string on MPPT 1) and modelled clear-sky plane-of-array irradiance. Outside that window the string output was clamped near 35 W by the off-grid system, so the rest of the day is not used.

frameRatioBasis: k = test-frame / reference-frame unshaded output. The thesis estimates k from paired unshaded days (about 0.98); 0.99 is the default here and is editable.

racks.basis: Measured from the raw LiDAR scans (tools/verify_geometry.py notes): base rails at 0.08-0.22 m height and post centres, world coordinates (Frame A lower-edge midpoint = origin, x east, y north). Frame B's rack is identical in all three sessions.
